## Summary
A UI/UX overhaul plus a rename: **CartPilot → Autocart** (a play on Instacart).

### What changed for the user
- **White & green theme to match T&T:** brand green `#00843D`, deep green `#0B4F2E`, mint tints, white cards on a soft green-grey background, and the Inter font.
- **Feels like a web app:**
  - top bar with the Autocart logo, a live status pill and an account menu;
  - a **step sidebar** (Profile → Meal plan → Cart → Build cart), with done, active and locked states; it becomes a pill bar on phones;
  - a **live cart summary rail** (total vs budget, items, next action), which becomes a sticky bottom bar on smaller screens;
  - the app opens the step that matches what's happening.
- **Plan & price in one go:** one button plans the meals, and the server **starts T&T pricing automatically** when the plan is ready. The Cart step shows the shopping list straight away with "Finding T&T price…" placeholders, which turn into the editable cart (swap / packs / remove / search again).
- **The agent lives in Build cart:** approval, the **live TinyFish browser views**, each agent's current action, Stop, and per-item outcomes are all in one section.
- **Signed-out landing page:** hero, cart mock-up, and 3 feature tiles.
- **Profile** is grouped into cards (Budget & household · Food preferences · Pantry & store), with a sticky save bar.

### Under the hood
- `src/ui.jsx`: shared UI kit (buttons, cards, chips, notices, skeletons, inline SVG icons, budget meter).
- `src/AppShell.jsx`, `src/Landing.jsx`, `src/useTask.js`, and the step components in `src/steps/`. The old `PlanPanel.jsx` is removed. `src/styles.css` is rewritten around design tokens.
- **Server:** `startPlanningTask` chains into `startResearchTask` (`autoPrice`, on by default). A new test covers it.
- **Dev-only design preview:** `src/dev/preview.html?state=…` renders every state with sample data produced by the real server logic (`consolidate`, `researchList`, `summarize`, `planCartRun`) on captured T&T results. It isn't part of the production build.
- **Rename** across the UI, title, favicon, README, package name and TinyFish integration tag. The Auth0 API identifier stays `https://cartpilot-api`, because renaming it would break login.

## Verification
- [x] `npm test`: 83 pass (1 new: automatic pricing after planning)
- [x] `vite build` passes
- [x] Checked in Chrome with the design preview at desktop width: profile, meal plan, pricing placeholders, priced cart with T&T product photos, building (live views + agent actions + Stop), built
- [x] Phone width (390px, checked in frames): no sideways page scroll on cart, build or landing; the step bar scrolls sideways by design
- [ ] Manual with a real login: plan → prices fill in automatically → approve → watch the agent in Build cart

EOF

content.text:
Autocart's redesign is done: **PR #10: https://github.com/GLeanM/HackWestern13/pull/10**. All 83 tests pass and the build succeeds. I checked every screen in Chrome using a preview page with sample data, but haven't run it with a real sign-in.

**What changed:**
- **Autocart name:** in the app, tab title, favicon, landing page, README and package name. The Auth0 API identifier stays `https://cartpilot-api`, because renaming it would break login.
- **White and green theme:** T&T-style greens on white cards with a modern font. It replaces the old plain look and the dark mode.
- **Web-app layout:**
  - a top bar with the logo, a live status ("Finding T&T prices…", "Agent is shopping…") and an account menu;
  - **four steps in a sidebar**: Profile → Meal plan → Cart → Build cart, each showing done, active or locked. On phones they become a scrollable bar.
  - a **live summary** of the cart total against your budget, with the next action button. It sits on the right on wide screens and in a bar at the bottom on smaller ones.
  - the app jumps to the right step as things happen.
- **Plan and price in one go:** **Plan & price my groceries** now plans the meals, and pricing starts automatically when the plan is ready. The Cart step shows your shopping list straight away with "Finding T&T price…" placeholders, which turn into the editable cart once prices arrive.
- **The agent is in Build cart:** approval, the live TinyFish browser views, what each agent is doing, the Stop button and the item results are all in that one section now.
- **Landing page:** a proper signed-out home page, and the profile is grouped into cards.

**What I checked in Chrome:**
- **Every screen** at desktop size: profile, meal plan, the price placeholders, the priced cart with real T&T product photos, the agent building, and the finished build.
- **Phone width (390px):** no sideways scrolling on the cart, build cart or landing pages.

The preview page (dev only, not included in the production build) is at `http://localhost:5173/src/dev/preview.html?state=priced`, with states landing, profile, planning, researching, priced, building and built.

**For you to try:** merge #10, hard-refresh http://localhost:5173, sign in, then press **Plan & price my groceries**. Check that prices fill in on their own and that the agent shows up in Build cart, then tick the last box on the PR.
